LanguageData.Gun_Lewis_Gun_RWP.label: Lewis Gun
LanguageData.Gun_Lewis_Gun_RWP.description: The Lewis Gun is a light machine gun featuring a distinctive circular magazine and high fire rate. Designed for sustained cover fire, it offers moderate accuracy and a balanced range, making it effective for suppressing enemy targets. Its notable weight and slower handling time are compensated by its reliability in prolonged engagements.
